long: Jet Set Radio is a cel-shaded action game where players control a gang of rollerblading youths who spray graffiti and grind across the streets of Tokyo-to. Players evade police and rival gangs while tagging territory in time-pressured stages set to an eclectic soundtrack. The 2012 PC port by BlitWorks brings the Dreamcast classic to modern hardware with high resolution support.
name: Jet Set Radio
short: Jet Set Radio (Smilebit/SEGA 2000, Blitworks 2012 PC port, via Proton)
